reason: The E1149/E0421 XGBoost backbone was fitted with a fixed 900-round budget and no eval_set or early-stopping history. The only per-epoch curves were the TD-WSA field-encoder self-supervised reconstruction curves (curves_s*.json), which were registered run outputs but are absent because the original run directory is missing. No curve was reconstructed or fabricated.
deletion_context: During the 2026-10-25 literature-transfer round the shared Python runtime and leaderboard/store were externally deleted. The runtime and ch-v1/ace.parquet were restored from exact-hash snapshots, but the E1466 run directory and the rest of the store were not restored. The registered hashes above are retained in research/expos/graph.jsonl.
scope: This visualization uses archived official predictions and the frozen folds/truth snapshot. It does not retrain the model, does not read official truth during fitting, and does not change the recorded gate failures.
